decision: Owner standing rule 2026-10-13 (Resilience rule): do not quit and do not complain about limits. When one path hits a problem, find another reasonable path and solve it yourself; involve the owner only when it truly cannot be done without them. On a block, a worker tries at least two alternative reasonable paths (e.g. copy instead of symlink; installed Chrome instead of a downloaded browser) before reporting a blocker. The report states which paths were tried and the result. Blockers go to the status board only if no workable path remains. Reports contain no excuses and no lists of restrictions, only done / not done / measured time.
